# langsmith_datasets (Data Source)

Lists LangSmith **datasets** in the current workspace via GET [`/api/v1/datasets`](https://api.smith.langchain.com/openapi.json). Optional arguments mirror the API's query parameters for filtering, pagination, and sorting. Repeated query keys are mapped from Terraform lists: `ids` → `id`, `data_types` → `data_type`, `tag_value_ids` → `tag_value_id`, and `exclude` → `exclude` (OpenAPI currently defines only the `example_count` value for `exclude`). The API caps `limit` at 100 (OpenAPI default 100). The `metadata` argument is forwarded as a single string; consult the LangSmith API for the expected encoding. Nested `datasets` attributes match the `langsmith_dataset` data source (the OpenAPI `Dataset.baseline_experiment_id` field is not included there and is omitted here as well). For a single dataset by id or name, use the `langsmith_dataset` data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List datasets in the current workspace with optional API filters.
# See the provider docs for supported query parameters (pagination, sort, name filters, etc.).

data "langsmith_datasets" "all" {}

output "dataset_ids" {
  value = [for d in data.langsmith_datasets.all.datasets : d.id]
}

data "langsmith_datasets" "recent_kv" {
  data_types = ["kv"]
  limit      = 20
  sort_by    = "modified_at"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `data_types` (List of String) Filter by one or more dataset `data_type` values; sent as repeated `data_type` query keys. Each element must be `kv`, `llm`, or `chat` per OpenAPI `DataType`.
- `exclude` (List of String) Sent as repeated `exclude` query parameters. OpenAPI only defines `example_count` today (`GetDatasetsSelect`).
- `exclude_corrections_datasets` (Boolean) When `true`, sends `exclude_corrections_datasets=true`. When unset, the API default (`false`) applies.
- `ids` (List of String) Dataset UUIDs to filter by; sent as repeated `id` query parameters. The LangSmith OpenAPI types this as an array of UUID strings.
- `limit` (Number) Page size (`limit`). OpenAPI allows 1–100 (default 100).
- `metadata` (String) Metadata filter string passed through to the API (`metadata` query parameter). Format is defined by the LangSmith API.
- `name` (String) Exact name filter (`name` query parameter).
- `name_contains` (String) Substring name filter (`name_contains` query parameter).
- `offset` (Number) Pagination offset (`offset`, default 0 in OpenAPI).
- `sort_by` (String) Sort column from OpenAPI `SortByDatasetColumn`: `name`, `created_at`, `last_session_start_time`, `example_count`, `session_count`, or `modified_at`. When unset, the API default (`last_session_start_time`) applies.
- `sort_by_desc` (Boolean) When `true`, descending sort; when `false`, ascending. When unset, the API default (`true`) applies.
- `tag_value_ids` (List of String) Tag value UUIDs to filter by; sent as repeated `tag_value_id` query parameters.

### Read-Only

- `datasets` (Attributes List) Datasets returned by the API for the current request (up to `limit`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--datasets))
- `id` (String) Stable placeholder (`datasets`) so the data source can be referenced.

<a id="nestedatt--datasets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `datasets`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `data_type` (String) Dataset data type (`kv`, `llm`, or `chat`).
- `description` (String) Dataset description.
- `example_count` (Number) Number of examples in the dataset.
- `externally_managed` (Boolean) Whether the dataset is externally managed.
- `id` (String) Dataset UUID.
- `inputs_schema_definition` (String) JSON string of the inputs JSON schema definition.
- `last_session_start_time` (String) Start time of the last session, if any.
- `metadata` (String) JSON string of the dataset metadata.
- `modified_at` (String) Last modification timestamp.
- `name` (String) Dataset name.
- `outputs_schema_definition` (String) JSON string of the outputs JSON schema definition.
- `session_count` (Number) Number of sessions associated with the dataset.
- `tenant_id` (String) Workspace (tenant) UUID.
- `transformations` (String) JSON string of the dataset transformations.
